name: Combobox
summary: A text field with a filtered list of suggestions. Choose from the list or type to narrow it.

anatomy.purpose: Text field that filters the list.
Options that match what was typed.

variants.name: Select only
variants.use: Pick one from a long list (countries).

variants.name: Free text
variants.use: Suggestions, but any text is allowed.

whenToUse: Long lists where scanning is slow.
whenNotToUse: Fewer than 7 options: use a select or radio buttons.
Searching a whole site: use a search field.

keyboard: Arrow Down opens and moves through options.
accessibility.focus: Focus stays in the input; the active option uses aria-activedescendant.
notes: Selected item needs a check, not color alone.
